products.name: Adepta Sororitas Battle Sister Sister Jurel
products.description_text:
Description Product Parameters T he Adepta Sororitas Battle Sister Set from Warhammer 40k to life with this new sequence of 1/18 scale figures. Recreate an essential battles with these extraordinarily detailed and articulated figures. Dominions are Sisters of Battle who are trained to use specialist close-range weaponry such as Flamers, Storm Bolters and Meltaguns. They are among their Orders’ most aggressive warriors, driven by the need to destroy the Emperor’s foes. Though their training has tampered the worst of their impetuosity, Dominions still yearn to fight at the forefront of any Sororitas attack

products.name: Black Templars Intercessor with Bolt Rifle, Bolt Pistol and Chainsword
products.description_text:
Description Product Information Born from ten thousand years of secret research by   Archmagos Dominus Belisarius Cawl   at the behest of Primarch   Roboute Guilliman , the   Primaris Intercessors   represent the next step in the evolution of the Space Marines — stronger, more resilient, and more lethal than their Firstborn predecessors. Armed with the   Mark II Cawl Pattern Bolt Rifle , a weapon of superior range and armour penetration, a   Bolt Pistol   for close quarters, and a   Chainsword   for when the enemy closes to melee, each Intercessor is a complete and lethal weapon in their own right. These warriors form the beating heart of the   Adeptus Astartes   battleline — holding ground against onrushing hordes, securing vital objectives, and pouring withering salvoes of fire into the enemy long before lesser warriors could even bring their guns to bear. This set celebrates ten of the Imperium's most legendary Chapters, each warrior bearing the proud colours and heraldry of their brotherhood: the noble   Ultramarines , the bloodthirsty   Blood Angels , the iron-willed   Iron Hands , the stalwart   Imperial Fists , the savage   Space Wolves , the stoic   Dark Angels , the resilient   Salamanders , the swift   White Scars , the shadowed   Raven Guard , and the zealous   Black Templars . Ten Chapters. Ten legacies. One unyielding purpose:   For the Emperor. 
 Product Description
 Series: Warhammer 40K 
 Size: 12.7 cm (5 inches)

For  seven  is the sacred, unholy number of the Plague God —  the integer infectum  — and  Primarch Mortarion's  obsession with it borders on the manic, infecting every level of his Legion. When a Tallyman's count aligns with Nurgle's blessed numeral, empyric energy surges through the souls of the Death Guard, spurring them to greater feats of plague-ridden slaughter. Through crackling  vox-speakers , he bellows sacred chants of the three and of the seven across the battlefield, driving his brothers into a festering zealous fervour. In close quarters, he carries a  Plasma Pistol  — a weapon of searing heat in the hands of a warrior who welcomes all manner of affliction

products.name: KOF'98UM Art of Fighting Team
products.description_text:
Description Role Introduction 
   KOF'98UM
Art of Fighting Team
The core team of Kyokugenryu Karate, founded by Takuma Sakazaki, consists of his son Ryo Sakazaki, his daughter Yuri Sakazaki, and his disciple Robert Garcia. Though all three come from the same school, their styles could not be more different: Ryo is fierce and pure, every strike the ultimate expression of fundamentals, earning him the name "the Invincible Dragon"; Robert is swift and razor-sharp, his techniques flashy and precise, layering his own talent over the Kyokugenryu foundation to claim the title "the Strongest Tiger"; Yuri turns the hardness of her father and brother into lightness, fighting with agility and variety and carving out a place all her own within the team. Dragon, tiger, and swallow: one school, three styles.
Ryo Sakazaki
Heir to Kyokugenryu Karate and the current head instructor of the dojo, Ryo Sakazaki was forged from childhood under the strict training of his father, Takuma Sakazaki, carving Kyokugenryu's creed of ending a fight with a single decisive blow into his very bones. There is no trickery in his martial art. Ko'ou Ken expresses that most clearly: a measured, domineering blast of gathered power, released only to strike after the opponent moves and still beat them there. When he needs to break a stalemate, he lowers his body and skims across the ground, trading height for speed with Hien Shippu Kyaku to cut in front of his opponent in an instant. If the enemy tries to suppress him from the air, Kohou answers with a charged rising blow. It is not technique that defines that attack, but the instinctive counter that erupts the moment he is pressed. And when mind and body are pushed to their limit, the ultimate form of Ko'ou Ken appears: Haoh Shokoken, turning all his gathered power into a massive shockwave that tears through everything ahead.
But these are only his conventional weapons. Kyokugenryu's secret art, Ryuuko Ranbu, is his true trump card. Once unleashed, fists, feet, elbows, and knees become an unbroken frenzy of attacks, abandoning every trace of defense and leaving only relentless forward momentum. It was with that retreatless fist that he earned the name "the Invincible Dragon" in a life-and-death clash with South Town overlord Geese Howard.
Robert Garcia
Born into an illustrious Italian family, Robert Garcia could have stayed far from the strife of the fighting world. But as a boy he witnessed the might of Kyokugenryu and was completely captivated, traveling to Japan alone to study under Takuma Sakazaki. From total outsider to a fighter strong enough to stand shoulder to shoulder with Ryo Sakazaki, he rose on the back of extraordinary talent and a competitive spirit far beyond the ordinary.
Unlike Ryo's steadiness, Robert's fighting style is fast and razor-edged. Ryuu Geki Ken is born from Ko'ou Ken, but abandons the path of direct collision; it is slyer, faster, and designed to cut into the instant before an opponent's power fully comes together. Hien Ryuujin Kyaku raises the advancing force of Hien Shippu Kyaku to another level, taking to the air for a wider kicking range and landing points far harder to predict, drawing a precise slash across the sky. Genei Kyaku pushes speed to its limit: a burst of multiple kicks so fast that afterimages seem to remain in place, and by the time an opponent blocks the first kick, the rest are already impossible to stop.
All of these techniques point to one truth: he is the sharpest blade in Kyokugenryu, not built to crush through a defense, but to tear it open. And when the battle demands everything, his Ryuuko Ranbu comes out as well. Unlike Ryo's version, Robert's flurry is ferocious without ever losing control, every strike landing exactly on the moment his opponent falls off balance. If Ryo's Ryuuko Ranbu is a storm, Robert's is a scalpel.
Over the years, he and Ryo Sakazaki have been rivals and comrades in equal measure, constantly testing each other and standing side by side countless times. That pride, the refusal to fall behind anyone, is what tempered his own title within Kyokugenryu: "the Strongest Tiger."
Yuri Sakazaki
Ryo Sakazaki's sister and Takuma Sakazaki's daughter, Yuri Sakazaki entered Kyokugenryu for reasons that had nothing to do with formal training. Her brother and father were always away, and she refused to be the one who simply waited at home. From awkward beginnings to the easy confidence she now displays, she forged a path entirely different from theirs: in Yuri's hands, the hardness of Kyokugenryu becomes lightness.
Her Ko'ou Ken has not yet reached the heavy force of her brother's, but it comes out faster and with greater flexibility, like an arrow loosed ahead of expectation. Under her feet, Hien Shippu Kyaku is no longer a desperate forward rush, but a true flying swallow, gliding lightly across the battlefield, able to change direction at any moment, tracing an arc through the air before striking with precision. Her real signature, however, is Raiou Ken, a downward burst of power thrown from the air that fuses Kyokugenryu's force with the nimbleness that is uniquely hers. That move belongs to no one else. She carved it out for herself.
When it is time to end the fight, she can unleash Haoh Shokoken as well. Its force may not equal the weight behind her father's or brother's, but its strength lies in surprise: no one expects a shockwave of that scale from so slender a figure. She does not need anyone's approval. Her fists are answer enough.

Description Product Information 
   Born from ten thousand years of secret research by   Archmagos Dominus Belisarius Cawl   at the behest of Primarch   Roboute Guilliman , the   Primaris Intercessors   represent the next step in the evolution of the Space Marines — stronger, more resilient, and more lethal than their Firstborn predecessors.    Sons of Horus Dark Emissary Consul — The Warmaster's Unrelenting Gaze 
 Where the   Warmaster Horus Lupercal   could not be present, his will was made manifest through the   Dark Emissaries   — an elite cadre of specialised   Consuls   drawn exclusively from the most fanatically loyal warriors of the   Sons of Horus Legion . Equal parts diplomat, enforcer, and executioner, a Dark Emissary served as the watchful eyes and iron fist of the Warmaster across a galaxy-spanning rebellion. They ensured unflinching obedience in every ally and servant who had pledged service to Horus — from Traitor Auxilia and Fallen Nobles to the Traitor Legions themselves. Should any warrior falter in their commitment or dare display seditious intentions, the Dark Emissary had the full authority to act as their executioner. Each one is a paragon of skill and martial prowess, bearing the iconic   Staff of Dark Authority   — topped with the   Eye of Horus   — a symbol of absolute power granted directly by the Warmaster himself, and a brutal weapon in its own right.

   Vheren Ashurhaddon — The First Reaver, Master of the True Sons 
 Known across the Sons of Horus as   "The First Reaver" ,   Vheren Ashurhaddon   is a   Cadre-Captain   of the   XVI Legion   and the unyielding master of the   True Sons of Cthonia   — a warrior society he forged from the most honourable and battle-hardened Sons of Horus who refused to surrender their Legion's identity to the corrupting influence of Chaos. Born in the labyrinthine underworld tunnels of   Cthonia   itself, Ashurhaddon rose through the ranks of the Luna Wolves through sheer martial ferocity, pioneering the brutal close-assault tactics that would give birth to the legendary   Reaver Attack Squads . Even as the rest of the Traitor Legions descended into wanton slaughter and daemonic excess, he stood apart — cultivating his True Sons as exemplars of discipline, honour, and the old Cthonian ways of war. products.description_text:
Description Product Information 
   A battle-proven icon of the   Adeptus Astartes   arsenal, the   Predator Destructor   is the original and most enduring pattern of the Predator main battle tank — a design whose origins stretch back to the   Dark Age of Technology , forged in direct response to humanity's earliest and most brutal encounters with the Ork race. Built upon the venerable   Rhino chassis , the Predator sacrifices its troop-carrying capacity entirely in exchange for massively reinforced frontal armour and a devastating heavy weapons platform. At its heart is the fearsome   Syrtis Pattern Autocannon   — mounted in a fully traversable turret and fitted with an automatic ammunition feed, muzzle flash suppressor, and discharge extractor — its explosive rounds, each larger than a Space Marine's fist, capable of tearing through massed infantry formations and shredding light vehicles with equal contempt. Flanking it on either side, the sponson-mounted   Godwyn-Tadcoke Pattern Heavy Bolters   pour out a relentless storm of mass-reactive bolts to shred anything that dares approach the tank's flanks. In the proud blue and gold of the   Ultramarines XIII Legion , this rolling fortress of ceramite and adamantine is a symbol of the indomitable will of   Macragge   — ten thousand years of war distilled into steel, fire, and unyielding purpose.   Courage and Honour.

products.description_text:
Description Product Information 
   Born from ten thousand years of secret research by   Archmagos Dominus Belisarius Cawl   at the behest of Primarch   Roboute Guilliman , the   Primaris Intercessors   represent the next step in the evolution of the Space Marines — stronger, more resilient, and more lethal than their Firstborn predecessors. Armed with the   Mark II Cawl Pattern Bolt Rifle , a weapon of superior range and armour penetration, a   Bolt Pistol   for close quarters, and a   Chainsword   for when the enemy closes to melee, each Intercessor is a complete and lethal weapon in their own right. These warriors form the beating heart of the   Adeptus Astartes   battleline — holding ground against onrushing hordes, securing vital objectives, and pouring withering salvoes of fire into the enemy long before lesser warriors could even bring their guns to bear. This set celebrates ten of the Imperium's most legendary Chapters, each warrior bearing the proud colours and heraldry of their brotherhood: the noble   Ultramarines , the bloodthirsty   Blood Angels , the iron-willed   Iron Hands , the stalwart   Imperial Fists , the savage   Space Wolves , the stoic   Dark Angels , the resilient   Salamanders , the swift   White Scars , the shadowed   Raven Guard , and the zealous   Black Templars . Ten Chapters. Ten legacies. One unyielding purpose:   For the Emperor.

Born from ten thousand years of secret research by Archmagos Dominus Belisarius Cawl at the behest of Primarch Roboute Guilliman, the Primaris Intercessors represent the next step in the evolution of the Space Marines — stronger, more resilient, and more lethal than their Firstborn predecessors. Armed with the Mark II Cawl Pattern Bolt Rifle, a weapon of superior range and armour penetration, a Bolt Pistol for close quarters, and a Chainsword for when the enemy closes to melee, each Intercessor is a complete and lethal weapon in their own right. These warriors form the beating heart of the Adeptus Astartes battleline — holding ground against onrushing hordes, securing vital objectives, and pouring withering salvoes of fire into the enemy long before lesser warriors could even bring their guns to bear. This set celebrates ten of the Imperium's most legendary Chapters, each warrior bearing the proud colours and heraldry of their brotherhood: the noble Ultramarines, the bloodthirsty Blood Angels, the iron-willed Iron Hands, the stalwart Imperial Fists, the savage Space Wolves, the stoic Dark Angels, the resilient Salamanders, the swift White Scars, the shadowed Raven Guard, and the zealous Black Templars. Ten Chapters. Ten legacies. One unyielding purpose: For the Emperor.
